description:
Build Beyond Earth. Innovate Beyond Limits. 🚀

TECHFEST 2026–27 is a 24-hour Space Technology Hackathon where innovators, developers, and problem-solvers come together to build solutions for the future of space technology.

Explore challenges across AI/ML, Cybersecurity, Data, Satellite Systems, IoT, Robotics, Earth Observation, Communication, and more.

🛰️ 5–6 October 2026
📍 Smt. Indira Gandhi College of Engineering, Navi Mumbai
🏆 ₹35,000 Prize Pool
⚡ 2 Rounds | Online PPT Submission → Offline 24-Hour Hackathon

The mission starts with an idea. Build it. Test it. Take it beyond. 🌌

hackathon_faqs.answer: TECHFEST 2026–27 is a 24-hour hackathon centered around the theme Space Technology, where participants will build innovative solutions to real-world challenges.
hackathon_faqs.question: What is Techfest 2026-27

hackathon_faqs.answer: The theme is Space Technology 🛰️. Problem statements will cover multiple technology domains such as AI/ML, Cybersecurity, Data Management, Satellite Systems, IoT, Robotics, Earth Observation, and more
hackathon_faqs.question: What is the theme of the Hackathon?

hackathon_faqs.answer: The hackathon takes place on 5th–6th October 2026 at Smt. Indira Gandhi College of Engineering, Navi Mumbai. Round 1 is online, while the final 24-hour round is offline.
hackathon_faqs.question: When and Where is the hackathon is happening

hackathon_faqs.answer:
There are two rounds:

Round 1: Online PPT submission
Round 2: Hybrid24-hour hackathon for shortlisted teams
hackathon_faqs.question: What is the hackathon format ?

hackathon_faqs.answer: The official problem statements will be revealed 24 hours before the hackathon. Participants will be able to access them through the official hackathon platform.
